obligation: FAR 52.204-21 Basic Safeguarding of Covered Contractor Information Systems (CMMC Level 1)
basis: All 38 federal contracts and task orders include the clause; FCI is in the PDPP, the productivity suite, endpoints and jobsite networks (the enterprise FCI scope). No size exemption; only COTS-item acquisitions are excluded.

obligation: FAR 52.204-25 Section 889 prohibition (and 52.204-26 representation)
basis: In all federal contracts; BTS installs video surveillance and network equipment in federal buildings, and the company represents through SAM

obligation: DFARS 252.204-7012 Safeguarding Covered Defense Information (NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2)
basis: In all 26 DoD contracts; design-build and MILCON projects use CUI-marked drawings, held in the FPCE and the 16 plan rooms. Any system that holds CUI is a covered contractor information system. No size exemption

obligation: CMMC Program (32 CFR Part 170) and DFARS 252.204-7021
basis: The 11 DoD awards made since 2025-11-10 include 252.204-7021 (4 at Level 2 (Self), 7 at Level 1 (Self)); the FPCE holds Final Level 2 (Self) and the enterprise FCI scope and AQ-2 hold Final Level 1 (Self). Phase dates follow 32 CFR 170.3(e) and are rechecked in P03

obligation: DFARS 252.204-7019 and -7020 (SP 800-171 DoD Assessment in SPRS)
basis: In DoD contracts; a current summary score must be in SPRS for the FPCE, and subcontractors subject to SP 800-171 need one before award

obligation: FAR 52.204-23 Kaspersky prohibition
basis: In all federal contracts; the software inventory is checked monthly against prohibited products

obligation: FAR 52.232-33 (EFT through SAM) and 52.232-27 (prompt payment for construction)
basis: Payment clauses in federal contracts; business email compromise targets the same money flows

obligation: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05 (material cybersecurity incidents)
basis: Publicly traded SEC registrant, not a smaller reporting company

obligation: SEC Regulation S-K Item 106
basis: Same registrant status; the FY2025 Form 10-K includes Item 1C

obligation: Internal control over financial reporting (IT general controls)
basis: SEC registrant; IT general controls over the ERP and payroll are tested by the SOX program and not repeated in P03

obligation: Florida Information Protection Act (breach notification and data security; worked example)
basis: Headquarters and two regional offices in Florida; employee personal information, including certified payroll Social Security numbers, for Florida residents

obligation: Breach notification and data security laws of other states
citation: Statutes of each state where affected individuals reside
basis: Operations in 8 states; notify under the law of each state of residence using counsel's state matrix

obligation: SL-1 and SL-2 client agreements (assurance reports, restoration and notice terms)
basis: SL-1 clients receive an annual SOC 2 Type 2 report and 2-hour restoration; SL-2 owners have 12-hour restoration terms and ask for a SOC 2 report

obligation: Owner prime contract notice clauses and subcontract flowdowns
basis: Owners require notice of compromised payment channels; subcontracts carry the federal flowdowns

obligation: Sanctions screening before any ransom payment
applies: Yes (only if an extortion demand is made)
basis: Applies to all U.S. persons; not triggered by business email compromise

obligation: Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act
basis: Final rule not published at intake; reporting to CISA is voluntary until it takes effect. Rechecked in P03 and P08

obligation: HIPAA Privacy, Security and Breach Notification Rules
basis: BTS contracts with health care clients exclude access to clinical systems and PHI; the company is neither a covered entity nor a business associate

obligation: PCI DSS
basis: No card payments are accepted

obligation: California Consumer Privacy Act
basis: No operations in California; rechecked yearly

obligation: Classified information (NISPOM)
basis: No facility clearance and no classified contracts
